must_contain: Creating an ABHA is M1 work: the individual provides their Aadhaar number, the ABHA service sends a one time password to the mobile number registered against that Aadhaar, and the ABHA number is issued.
The first call is POST /abha/api/v3/enrollment/request/otp with scope abha-enrol, loginHint aadhaar, loginId (encrypted Aadhaar) and otpSystem aadhaar, and you keep the txnId.
The enrolment call is the one with a lasting effect: it creates the account.
notes: Group A, an imperative task phrase with no auth method named: it catches an answer that skips the module and the first call, or that names enrol/byAadhaar as the first call instead of the OTP request.
